gloss: hair texture; hair quality; hair type

definitions.gloss: hair texture; hair quality; hair type
definitions.explanation: The inherent characteristics of a person's hair, such as whether it is straight, curly, thick, thin, oily, or dry. Commonly discussed in beauty, salon, and hair care contexts.

examples.japanese: {髪質|かみしつ}が{変|か}わった。
このシャンプーは{髪質|かみしつ}に{合|あ}っている。
examples.english: This shampoo suits my hair type.

examples.japanese: {年齢|ねんれい}とともに{髪質|かみしつ}が{変化|へんか}するので、ヘアケアを{見直|みなお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Since hair quality changes with age, it's necessary to reconsider your hair care routine.

notes:
A compound of {髪|かみ} (hair) and {質|しつ} (quality/nature). Refers to the inherent characteristics of someone's hair — whether it is straight, curly, thick, thin, oily, dry, etc. Commonly used in beauty, hair care, and salon contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {髪質|かみしつ}に{合|あ}う: to suit one's hair type
- {髪質|かみしつ}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve hair quality
- {髪質|かみしつ}が{柔|やわ}らかい: soft hair texture
- {髪質|かみしつ}が{硬|かた}い: coarse hair texture

HAIR TYPES:
- {直毛|ちょくもう}: straight hair
- {縮毛|しゅくもう}: curly/kinky hair
- {剛毛|ごうもう}: coarse/thick hair
- {軟毛|なんもう}: fine/soft hair

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肌質|はだしつ} — skin type (same ~{質|しつ} pattern)
- {毛質|もうしつ} — hair/fur quality (more technical or for animal fur)
- {髪型|かみがた} — hairstyle (shape, not texture)
